INVALID:This isn't a valid address, and it shouldn't appear as the destination or source address of a packet.

PREFERRED:This is a valid address that can appear as the destination or source address of a packet.
TENTATIVE:The uniqueness of the address on the link is being verified.  Addresses in this state should not be used for general communication and should only be used to determine the uniqueness of the address.
UNKNOWN:The status cannot be determined for some reason.

pending-master:The SRRP instance is in master mode. All traffic is forwarded using the native MAC address of the interface SRRP is running on.
